result.title: Causal Dioramas: Controllable Video Generation, Revision and Editing via Intervention
result.summary: Two centuries ago, an early cinema-like theater called the Diorama could already control its scenes at will. Today's video generation models produce videos of near-cinematic quality, yet they still lack this controllability. This limitation stems from the inherent semantic gap between text and pixels, since a prompt can describe a video only coarsely and leaves its details and relations beyond control. We bring this ability to video generation with Causal Dioramas, modules that decompose a video into a concept graph of variables that can be intervened on individually. Each instruction is translated into an intervention on the concept graph, modifying the specified concepts and their dependents. A connector then conveys this intervention to the video generator, which reuses the original noise to produce a counterfactual video while preserving all other content. Building on Causal Dioramas, we develop a unified framework for controllable generation, counterfactual revision of generated videos and editing of real videos. We outperform both open-source and commercial models in controllability on T2V-CompBench, CoVEBench and OpenVE-Bench.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 Causal Dioramas，将视频分解为可单独干预的概念图变量，把指令转成对概念及其依赖项的干预，并经连接器传递给视频生成器，在复用原始噪声的条件下生成保留其余内容的反事实视频，用于可控生成、生成视频修正与真实视频编辑。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「概念图变量干预＋复用噪声保留非目标内容」的思路，可能为 LVR 中按实体或属性编辑内部视觉状态、以及用反事实一致性检验 latent 内容贡献提供可核查的概念框架，但工作本身面向视频生成而非多模态推理。
